title: Analytic exact solutions to the nonlinear Dirac equation
summary: We present analytic exact solutions to the nonlinear Dirac equation: they display a ring singularity for the Nambu--Jona-Lasinio nonlinearity and a shell singularity for the Soler nonlinearity. For both cases, the size of the singular region is of the order of the Compton length. General comments about square-integrability will be addressed in terms of a solution to the linearized system.
